origin: floor level at the centre of the crystal growth
character: Dr. Leela Iyer, fused into a crystal growth up to the chest
skeleton: Skeleton3D with the same 28 bone names as the astronaut (legs exist but are hidden inside the crystal)

nodes.LeelaIyer: skinned body (upper body + head); crystal shards across her eyes and glowing eyes (EmitEyes) turn with the head
nodes.CrystalGrowth: static crystal mass (EmitCrystal dark glass, EmitCrystalGlow violet, EmitCrystalCore cyan veins)

clips.name: turn_head
clips.note: starts with the head bowed and turned away (to her right), slowly turns with a small hesitation to face +Z (the camera in front of her). Ends exactly in the idle start pose.

clips.name: idle
clips.note: facing +Z, slow breathing, tiny head drift and finger tremor

notes: Play turn_head when the player approaches, then loop idle. Put an OmniLight3D (violet) inside the crystal at about Godot (0, 0.6, 0) for the glow.
Rest/bind pose = first frame of turn_head (head bowed).
